definitions.explanation: The main body of a country's territory, as opposed to islands or overseas territories.

examples.japanese: {本土|ほんど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{本土|ほんど}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: To fly from Okinawa to the mainland.

examples.japanese: {本土|ほんど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{離島|りとう}→離島：14597_ritou⟧⟦では→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The climate differs between the mainland and remote islands.

examples.japanese: {本土|ほんど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}るには→渡る：02441_wataru⟧3⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes three hours to cross from the mainland to the island by boat.

examples.japanese: {本土|ほんど}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らない→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{売|う}られている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: Things that you can't get on the mainland are sold in abundance on this island.

notes:
{本土|ほんど} means the main landmass of a country, as opposed to islands, overseas territories, or outlying areas.

JAPAN CONTEXT:
In Japan, {本土|ほんど} usually refers to the four main islands (⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧, ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧, ⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧, ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧) as opposed to ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧ or ⟦{離島|りとう}→離島：14597_ritou⟧ (remote islands). This usage is especially common in Okinawa, where people distinguish between {本土|ほんど} and their own islands.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {本土|ほんど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to the mainland
- {本土|ほんど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧: an island far from the mainland

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧: Honshu (the largest of Japan's main islands)
- ⟦{離島|りとう}→離島：14597_ritou⟧: remote island
- ⟦{内地|ないち}→内地：28927_naichi⟧: mainland (older term, sometimes used in Hokkaido and Okinawa to refer to Honshu)
